summary: A release authored by Laura Smith of the Montgomery County District Attorney's Office reports the July 20–21, 2026 221st District Court trial, DWI (Third or More) conviction, 50-year jury punishment, 0.150 blood result, self-representation with standby counsel, and prosecutor claim that prior felony convictions established habitual-offender status.
